newsitem.title: UK: British brewers lobby European parliament.
newsitem.headline: British brewers lobby European parliament.

text.p: Robert Neame, chairman of Britain's oldest brewer Shepherd Neame, will deliver a petition to the Europeean parliament in Brussels today on behalf of independent brewers angered by the different levels of beer duty across Europe, said a spokesman for Shepherd Neame.
Neame will arrive outside parliament's main entrance with horses and dray, loaded up with barrels of real ale, the traditional way of delivering beer to British pubs.
The 38 independent family brewers across Britain are concerned that the high taxes on beer will lead to significant job losses in vulnerable regions.

The petition says that the wide discrepancies in excise duty between EC member states on alcholic drinks, and beer in particular, also distorts competition, encourages fraud and leads to a loss of revenue to governments.
